## SocialDataX 快手 Kuaishou MCP

Search Kuaishou videos and users; read trends, suggestions, video details, comments, replies, creator profiles, posts and video transcripts. This is a first-party SocialDataX integration to the SocialDataX hosted API; SocialDataX is independent of the social platforms whose data it provides. Use it to examine public content and compare the relevant posts, comments or profiles. Configure your own `SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY` as `Authorization: Bearer <SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY>`; [API Key and setup](https://socialdatax.com/ai?from=toolhive), with business calls billed in SocialDataX credits. Public connection materials are MIT; the hosted service implementation is proprietary.
